findings.text: blocking: `event = usable & ~split_wall & (...)` suppresses every ascending event at a wall vertex, so where a lower interior component meets the outside at a wall vertex the merge is recorded nowhere; the node's own outside-augmented oracle reports exactly one such mismatch on the production diverted-single-null fixture at the landed head (wall vertex 447, psi -0.003609), and the receipt keeps node-minus-edge equal to one only because the node and its arc are dropped together, so no check in the suite can see it.

follow-on: the oracle is parameterised only over the hill and rippled hill from :36, whose wall ring is the carrier's global minimum, so the wall-merge case the plan's rule carves out is not exercised and the over-suppression at nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py:420 passes green; a carrier whose interior minimum lies below its wall contact (r^2 on the same 21x21 triangulation) reports one wall merge mismatch.

follow-on: the log labelled working-tree-final-fix records wall node counts {0:0, 1:2}, which the landed head does not produce (it yields {0:0, 1:1}), so a reader comparing the run's census logs takes a superseded state for the landed one; the fragment's table records the reproducible number.

item_verdicts.diff: read all three commits from e4ca8d20 to 41a80bc4; 594ceacfe adds the ascending outside union to nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py together with tests/test_contour_tree_wall_split.py, a0ca54a37 lands the evidence fragment, and 41a80bc4 repins the two sparse receipt digests.
item_verdicts.done_when: the brief's measure is the joint gate at base and head plus the wall-node census on the diverted-single-null-340-cells fixture; the manifest records both arms complete (14/14 files, 20 base failures to 17 head, file-gates/base-aggregate.log and file-gates/head-aggregate.log), a red base control (negative-control.log, 5 failed, EXIT=1) and the before/after census, and the census number is what the landed head produces when re-run.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to attach the ascending (split) sweep's wall to the outside so no split-born wall extremum or saddle reaches the receipt; nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py:392-396 hands each ascending wall vertex the outside root as an extra neighbour and :419-420 suppresses the wall event, and the diverted 340-cell census falls from 18 minima and 20 saddles to 0 minima and 1 saddle.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the per-file gate result for each arm, the census before and after, the red control, the recorded added failures and two follow-ons, and the headline census it quotes (minimum 0, saddle 1) is reproduced by the landed head.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares five paths, and git diff e4ca8d20146f67c86c92bb84feb851c6c5a1ca60..41a80bc4f40d16ab153fc919efd69222cfd440b1 changes four of them, every one inside the declared scope, with nova/equilibrium/topology.py untouched as the brief required.

justifications.durability: tests/test_contour_tree_wall_split.py:127 carries an independent outside-augmented oracle that reddens when the old sweep is restored, but its fixture at :36 is a hill whose wall ring is the carrier's global minimum, so it cannot fail the over-suppression nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py:420 introduces.
justifications.evidence: file-gates/base-aggregate.log and file-gates/head-aggregate.log carry both arms to their summary lines with EXIT=1, and negative-control.log shows the reinstated defect reddening five tests, though after-wall-counts-final.log:5 records a census the landed head does not reproduce and the oracle was never run on a production carrier.
justifications.fit: nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py:392-396 extends _sweep_tree through the same fixed-shape fori_loop state it already threads, with no host-side filter, no new sweep and no plan label in any added name.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py:420 blanks every ascending event at a wall vertex, so the spurious chain is gone on the fixtures but the merge the plan's rule reserves for a wall vertex with a non-outside neighbour is dropped as well, verified on the production fixture at :420's guarded event.
justifications.reuse: _sweep_tree is the only owner of the merge-tree sweep and the change extends it, reusing its wall_flag, winner and union bookkeeping rather than adding a second wall mechanism.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff e4ca8d20..41a80bc4 touches only nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py, tests/test_contour_tree_wall_split.py, tests/test_contour_tree_sparse_build.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the manifest's declared write paths.
